'''Tenris Mirkblood''' is a withered located in the [[Wretched Ghetto]] in [[Alah'Thalas]].

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Cursed by our gluttony, we now stand close to our soon-to-be demise. See us as we stand, shattered, broken, and wretched amidst the rubble and unwanted much of our brethren. They have cast us aside, claiming they shall seek the salvation we cannot desire.

==Notes==
* Tenris Mirkblood is also a random name for Blood Mage heroes in ''Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne''.
* Tenris's model is a recolor of Kael'thas's model following his resurrection post-Tempest Keep in the Burning Crusade.
